platformer-0.1.0.description:
First version :tada: 

## Known issues

* Logic doesn't take into account weapon upgrades needed to reach space locations
* Logic doesn't take into account power generation (relevant past Aquilo where solar power is not enough)
platformer-0.1.0.title: Factorio: Platformer v0.1.0

platformer-0.1.1.description:
## Improvements
* Make upgrades counts defaults not include the first level of infinite tech (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/5)
* Removes meaningless option to change upgrade count where the min was equal to the max (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/11)

## Fixes
* Take into account electricity generation for space location logic (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/4)
* Add non-infinite damage upgrades as requirements for killing asteroids (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/8, https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/11, https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/12)
* Fix non-progressive science packs not having ids (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/10)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/compare/platformer-0.1.0...platformer-0.1.1
platformer-0.1.1.title: Factorio: Platformer v0.1.1

platformer-0.2.0.description:
## New features
* Add an option to randomize individual recipes instead of technologies (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/18)

## Improvements
* Remove asteroid chunk from craftsanity (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/15)
* Set minimum ap version in manifest to properly error when loading on older versions (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/22)

## Fixes
* Make steel axe technology filler since its bonus is useless without a character (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/20)
* Fixed that marking locations as checked were giving the wrong message (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/21)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/compare/platformer-0.1.1...platformer-0.2.0

platformer-0.3.0.description:
## Improvements
* Only set the first instance of a recipe as progressive (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/29)
* Add progressive pipe (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/34)
* Switch to a prefix for recipe item names (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/32)
* Improve advanced oil processing logic (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/36)

## Fixes
* Fix minimum craftsanity adjustment (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/33)
* Add missing recipe for automation (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/35)
* Fix receiving progressive items (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/37)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/compare/platformer-0.2.1...platformer-0.3.0
platformer-0.3.0.title: Factorio: Platformer v0.3.0

platformer-0.4.0.description:
## New features
* Split qualities and space locations into separate items when split technologies is on (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/38)
* Implements start inventory from pool (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/39)

## Improvements
* Set technologies as essential if they contain an advancement item (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/48)
* Move more texts to static locale file (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/53)
* Add uranium-fuel-cell and steam from boiler to logic (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/60)

## Fixes
* Sort craftsanity item pool to ensure consistent ordering (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/51)
* Fix free samples crashing when there is a platform pending construction (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/54, https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/56)
* Resync non-tech unlocks on technology effect reset (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/55)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/compare/platformer-0.3.0...platformer-0.4.0

platformer-0.5.0.description:
## New features
* Switch to [Platformer (2.1 Fork)](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/platformer-fork) for Factorio 2.1 compatibility (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/84)

## Improvements
* Sync client with Archipelago 0.6.8 Factorio Client (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/78)
* Make all instances of a recipe progressive instead of only the first one (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/82)

## Fixes
* Only send items to first platforms instead of all of them, this fix a crash when a platform was destroyed and makes more sense overall (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/81)
* Fix crash when item or player names contains quotes (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/77)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/compare/platformer-0.4.6...platformer-0.5.0
